component.name: SSHCnfgr
component.summary: Manage OpenSSH hosts, groups, and identities from a single TOML file

description.p: SSHCnfgr manages OpenSSH host configurations, groups, and SSH identity profiles from a single TOML file (~/.ssh/sshcnfgr.toml) and generates clean OpenSSH configs containing only enabled hosts.
Includes interactive duplicate detection and merging, extra SSH option editing, automatic timestamped backups, and both a Qt6 desktop GUI and a Textual TUI.
